coverage: All 50 waves render compact native closed rows with movement, count and actual key defenses; lore and intelligence explanations stay secondary.
All 62 effective profiles reconstruct shared/different statistics and trait descriptions exactly as real spawned enemies.
Common HP/armor/speed/movement and ability descriptions display once; mutually exclusive differences have responsive side-by-side form cards.
The existing mechanically identical wave29 pair is identified honestly; Moon Clan chance is not stacked or changed.
Native select/Go and boss controls reach wave45, boss50 and completed wave10 with exact campaign caps and focus on the opened native row.
Wave/lore disclosure, select focus/value and scrolling survive live/phase updates without forced reopening.
Explicit group variants/modifiers, empty variant arrays, run-local enemy timings and independent seeded per-enemy rolls follow actual engine semantics.
Existing updateWarbandsOverviewPanel signature and legacy card outputs remain compatible; 22 existing related checks passed unchanged.
Navigation/select/detail controls have 44px-or-larger CSS hit areas, visible focus and legacy-size overrides.

integration.mainHooks: None needed for catalog navigation; updateWarbandsOverviewPanel owns native controls and existing CSS import carries styles.
integration.persistentCombat: Root phase-ui.js/main owns persistent on-field/queued counts and revealed boss health; this proof certifies catalog coverage only.

limits: Real browser/native touch and responsive legibility remain root-owned integrated checks.
Catalog facts do not guarantee one form across a wave or establish damage/win probabilities.
Git-normalized protected code remains unchanged; byte hashes separately identify harmless checkout line endings.
No core/data/art/audio mutation, D001 tuning, MAIN/root-main changes, version or publication by this owner.
